name: Salsa Tortilla
source: Older of the Tortilla twins and vice-president of the Tortilla Company, Oasis' rival clan. She is tasked with operating Golem. Tortilla is always fighting with [url=/c9016]Carina[/url] over Leicester and being toyed by her sister, Ritos.
